description: Figure 6 illustrates the average number of tokens generated under varying numbers of shots with different few-shot styles. The horizontal axis represents the number of shots, labeled “Number of Shots,” with categories 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4, and is a linear scale. The vertical axis represents the average number of tokens, labeled “Average # Tokens,” with a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.60, with tick labels at intervals of 0.10. There are three sets of bars for each number of shots, representing different few-shot styles: “zero-shot,” colored blue; “one-shot,” colored orange; and “five-shot,” colored green. For each number of shots, the bars are grouped together, with zero-shot on the left, one-shot in the middle, and five-shot on the right. At zero shots, the zero-shot bar has a height of approximately 0.52, the one-shot bar is approximately 0.48, and the five-shot bar is approximately 0.42. At four shots, the zero-shot bar has a height of approximately 0.18, the one-shot bar is approximately 0.15, and the five-shot bar is approximately 0.12. The bars are arranged in ascending order of shot number, and no bars are visually emphasized.
